## Press Release


### Republic Bank Expands Financial Wellness Offerings with New Earned Wage Access Solution


Company Release - 11/17/2026 1:07 PM ET


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


*Republic Bank EarlyFunds™ allows clients to access money they've already earned before payday, with no loan and no credit check.*


LOUISVILLE, Ky.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Republic Bank (“Republic” or the “Bank”) has announced the launch of Republic Bank EarlyFunds™. This new digital banking offering gives clients access to a portion of their earned wages as soon as instantly.*


Designed to provide greater flexibility and control over personal finances, Republic Bank EarlyFunds™ allows qualifying clients with direct deposit at Republic to access up to $1,000* in earned wages before their payday. Clients can receive funds instantly for a small fee or through a no-cost standard delivery option.


Unlike traditional short-term borrowing options, Republic Bank EarlyFunds™ provides access to money clients have already earned. There are no credit checks, no interest charges, and no loans involved.


As demand for flexible financial tools continues to grow, earned wage access has become increasingly popular among digital banking platforms and industries such as QSR and retail. Republic is bringing that same convenience to clients through their trusted banking relationship, offering access without employment-based qualification requirements.


"People shouldn't have to wait for money they’ve already earned," said Logan Pichel, President and CEO of Republic Bank. "Having a service like Republic Bank EarlyFunds™ can make a real difference when unexpected expenses arise, or cash flow gets tight between paychecks. This is another example of how we're listening to our clients and using technology to create a banking experience that helps our clients THRIVE."


To use Republic Bank EarlyFunds™, clients must have an eligible Republic Bank checking account with direct deposit established. Available advance amounts are based on earnings and payroll activity.


For more information about Republic Bank EarlyFunds™, visit republicbank.com/EarlyFunds or stop by a local banking center.


** Eligibility requirements apply. Not all applicants will qualify. EarlyFunds Advance amounts range from $1-$1,000 and vary by client based on earned wages, payroll activity, account status, eligibility requirements, monthly advance limits, and Republic Bank approval. Direct deposit to a Republic Bank checking account required. Optional instant funding available for a $2 fee; standard delivery options may be available. Terms and Conditions apply. EarlyFunds is not a loan.*


*** Message and data rates may apply from your wireless carrier.*


**About Republic Bank**


Republic Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) is the parent company of Republic Bank & Trust Company (the “Bank”). The Bank operates 47 banking centers across five metropolitan statistical areas (“MSAs”) in five states. These include 22 banking centers in the Louisville MSA, serving Louisville, Prospect, Shelbyville, and Shepherdsville, Kentucky, and Floyds Knobs, Jeffersonville, and New Albany, Indiana; six banking centers in the Lexington MSA, serving Georgetown and Lexington, Kentucky; eight banking centers in the Cincinnati MSA, serving Kenwood, Norwood, and West Chester, Ohio, and Bellevue, Covington, Crestview Hills, and Florence, Kentucky; seven banking centers in the Tampa MSA, serving Largo, New Port Richey, Seminole, St. Petersburg, Tampa, and Temple Terrace, Florida; and four banking centers in the Nashville MSA, serving Cool Springs, Murfreesboro, Nashville, and Spring Hill, Tennessee. The Bank also offers online banking at[www.republicbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.republicbank.com&esheet=54642105&newsitemid=20261117300978&lan=en-US&anchor=www.republicbank.com&index=1&md5=6e243b71e827a54f1ec2510e826dbdd3) . The Company is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, and, as of September 30, 2026, had approximately $7.08 billion in total assets. The Company’s Class A Common Stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “RBCAA.”
